findings.evidence: Never infer a model's vendor from its name — always call infer-vendor (training knowledge is stale, consistency matters).

findings.fix: Cross-AI lane setup: detects installed CLIs and models, asks which to use for review and execute lanes and in what priority order, then writes the [lanes] table of ai-kit's config.toml. Use when the user asks to set up, refresh, migrate, or check cross-AI review or execute lanes, mentions .aikit/config.toml, review-spec.toml, --check-only, or ai-kit-spec-review warns that no config exists, even without saying "lanes". Not for running an already configured review, editing [runner] or [models], or writing secrets.env.

findings.evidence: Run the catalog flow and MANDATORY read references/catalog.md.
findings.fix: Gate each section of references/catalog.md by the case that needs it: web-query and record-web-names only for a kept runtime with no listing; herdr-names only when HERDR_ENV=1; models-config only when the user changes [models]. Keep the catalog-report read mandatory for every setup run.
State that --jev is the default when jev-fast-decision is installed and is omitted otherwise, so the two catalog commands do not present an unstated choice.

findings.evidence: The file has 9 should-trigger and 8 should-not-trigger queries.
findings.fix: Add one more realistic should-trigger query and two near-miss should-not-trigger queries, such as changing one lane's model without rerunning setup, so the set reaches about 20 with 8–10 on each side.
